data.plain_summary: You already have a lot of prior art that uses plant extracts for skin or oral health, and WO2020054204A1 even discloses a neem extract. However, none of the patents combine fresh neem leaves with turmeric and honey in a single‑use sachet for wound care. To stand out, specify the exact turmeric‑to‑honey ratio, use a special biodegradable sachet, or add a known wound‑healing peptide to the mix. Those tweaks will give your formulation a clearer technical edge.

examined_documents.text:
Abstract: The present invention relates to a composition for preventing, improving or treating periodontal disease, which contains Moringa oleifera extract and Eucommia bark extract as active ingredients. More specifically, the composite composition of Moringa oleifera extract and Eucommia bark extract according to the present invention provides a synergistic effect in improving periodontal diseases including gingivitis and periodontitis. In particular, it exhibits the effect of directly preventing or improving periodontal disease by improving alveolar bone loss and regeneration of alveolar bone through antioxidative, antibacterial, or anti-inflammatory effects. Therefore, it can be effectively used as food, medicine, quasi-drug, and the like.

Claim 1: 1.一种用于预防或改善牙周病的组合物，其包含辣木叶提取物和杜仲皮提取物作为活性成分，

Claim 2: 其中所述辣木叶提取物与所述杜仲皮提取物的重量比是2:1至4:1，

Claim 3: 其中所述辣木叶提取物通过使用水作为提取溶剂来制备，并且含有基于总的辣木叶提取物的1.2mg/g至5mg/g的黄芪甙，并且

Claim 4: 其中所述杜仲皮提取物通过使用水作为提取溶剂来制备，并且含有基于总的杜仲皮提取物的1.0mg/g至15mg/g的松脂醇二葡萄糖苷。

Claim 5: 2.根据权利要求1所述的组合物，其中所述组合物是药物组合物。

Claim 6: 3.根据权利要求1或2所述的组合物，其中所述辣木叶提取物与所述杜仲皮提取物的重量比是2:1或4:1。

examined_documents.text:
Abstract: The present invention is a herbal extract, anhydrous ethanol, aloe vera gel, hyaluronic acid, purified water, grapefruit seed extract, herbal oil cleansing composition consisting of essential oils, and the herbal hand cleansing manufacturing method to prepare a composition Eliminates neuralgia and sleep disturbances of the extract, Bone Tobacco, to alleviate skin diseases and wounds by the insecticidal and disinfectant effect of green tree, the insecticidal and disinfectant effect of paulownia, the sterilizing effect of ethanol and essential oil, and aloe Veragel, hyaluronic acid, and purified water inhibit aging of the skin of the hand while maintaining moisturizing of the skin of the hand. The present invention relates to a hand washing manufacturing method comprising a natural herbal extract for providing a material and a hand cleaning composition thereof.

Claim 1: 골담초, 음나무, 개오동나무 중 선택된 어느 하나를 이용하여 추출한 한방추출물과 무수에탄올, 알로에베라겔, 히알루론산, 정제수, 자몽씨추출물과 페퍼민트 에센셜오일, 라벤더 에센셜오일, 티트리 에센셜오일, 유칼립투스 에센셜오일이 혼합되거나 선택된 어느하나의  에센션오일(essential oil)로 구성되는 한방손세정제를 구성요소를 준비하는 단계(100)와;상기 무수에탄올을 계량하여 상기 에센셜오일(essential oil)과 혼합하여 무수에탄올 및 에센셜오일 제 1혼합수를 제조하는 단계(200)와;상기 혼합수에 상기 한방추출물, 알로에베라겔, 히알루론산, 자몽씨추출물, 정제수를 혼합하는 제 2혼합수를 제조하는 단계(300)와;상기 제 2혼합수를 용기에 포장하여 상온에서 1 내지 2일 보관하는 포장 및 보관하는 단계(500)로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 천연한방추출물을 포함하는 손세정제 제조방법.

Claim 2: 제 1항에 있어서,상기 제 2혼합수를 제조하는 단계(300)와, 상기 포장 및 보관하는 단계(500) 사이에  상기 제 2혼합수에 상에 부유된 오일을 제거하기 위하여 유화제를 투입하는 단계(350)가 더 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 천연한방추출물을 포함하는 손세정제 제조방법.

examined_documents.title: Antioxidant
examined_documents.text:
Abstract: Provided is an antioxidant for safely and efficiently reducing oxidative stress in vivo by promoting the expression of an antioxidative enzyme or a redox-related factor in vivo to thereby maintain good health and prevent various diseases and symptoms caused by oxidative stress. The antioxidant contains an extract of Albizia julibrissin and has, in particular, an effect of promoting the expression of an antioxidative enzyme gene and/or a redox-related factor gene.

Claim 1: ネムノキ抽出物を含有する抗酸化剤。

Claim 2: ネムノキ抽出物がネムノキ属植物の植物体からの水抽出物である請求項１に記載の抗酸化剤。

Claim 3: ネムノキ抽出物が、抗酸化関連酵素および／またはレドックス関連因子の遺伝子発現亢進作用を有する請求項１または２に記載の抗酸化剤。

Claim 4: 抗酸化関連酵素および／またはレドックス関連因子が、スーパーオキシドディスムターゼ（ＳＯＤ）、ペルオキシレドキシン（ＰＲＸ）、チオレドキシン（ＴＸＮ）、チオレドキシンレダクターゼ（ＴＲＤ）、グルタチオンレダクターゼ（ＧＲＤ）およびグルタレドキシン（ＧＸＮ）からなる群より選択される少なくともいずれか１種以上である、請求項１から３のいずれかに記載の抗酸化剤。

Claim 5: ネムノキ抽出物が、細胞内活性酸素低減作用を有することを特徴とする請求項１から４のいずれかに記載の抗酸化剤。

Claim 6: 請求項１～５のいずれかに記載の抗酸化剤を配合されてなる皮膚外用剤。

examined_documents.title: Diindolylmethane-based compositions and methods of use thereof for promoting …
examined_documents.text:
Abstract: The present invention includes compositions and methods for the treatment and prevention of oral mucosal disorders and for promotion of bone health. In particular, the present invention describes new therapeutic and preventative uses for 3,3′-diindolylmethane (DIM), or a DIM-related indole, alone or in combination with anti-inflammatory agents and/or antibacterial agents, to treat oral mucosal disorders and promote bone health. The compositions of the invention are used to prevent and reverse oral mucosal disorders and bone loss (osteopenia and osteoporosis) associated with aging and chronic inflammation. Oral mucosal disorders include Periodontitis, gingivitis and related oral mucosal inflammation. Formulations of the compositions of the invention include capsules, tablets, toothpastes, oral gels, mouthwashes, mouth rinses, lozenges, chewing gum, dental floss, and dental topical formulations, and fortified foods.

Claim 1: 1. A method for preventing or treating oral mucosal disorders, or a symptom thereof, comprising administering to a subject in need thereof a therapeutically effective amount of Diindolylmethane (DIM) or a DIM-related indole.

Claim 2: 2. The method of claim 1, wherein the administering is by systemic administration

Claim 3: 3. The method of claim 1, wherein the administering is by topical oral administration.

Claim 4: 4. The method of claim 1, wherein the symptom is calculus accumulation, apthous ulcer, oral malodor, gingivitis, periodontitis, alveolar bone loss, or loosening of teeth.

Claim 5: 5. The method of claim 1, wherein the subject is a human.

examined_documents.text:
Abstract: The present invention provides a toothpaste composition and a method for preparing the toothpaste composition for strengthening anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial resistance to tooth whitening, dental caries, oral disease and gum disease.
The present invention contains 3.5 ~ 5.0% by weight of dry lettuce powder in order to have a high whitening effect on the total weight of the toothpaste composition, which is mixed with dried herbal medicine consisting of Eochocho, gold and silver, worms and baekbaekpi, white paper, horse riding and donkey By adding 0.10 to 11.72% by weight of powder and alum to 0.01 to 1.21% by weight, anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties were added to prevent tooth decay and to have a great effect on oral disease, gum disease, periodontal disease gingivitis and periodontitis.
